'''Fifth Wheel''' was a small settlement located to the north of [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]] within the [[Scraplands/Legends|Scraplands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Twenty-five kilometers from the capital city, the village was known as the Jewel of the Scraplands, and was populated by scrap dealers and scavengers. The city's only attraction was an [[armored hovertrain]] station with service to Worlport; other places of note were a nameless cantina at the heart of town and a dusty marketplace.<ref name="MPQ" />
